content:
We have a new stable release of Lean v4.23.0 and a new release candidate: v4.24.0-rc1.

Please see the release notes for v4.23.0 and v4.24.0 for full details.

As usual Mathlib, doc-gen4, verso, Batteries, Aesop, and the REPL are available using these toolchain using the v4.23.0 and v4.24.0-rc1 tags at the respective repositories (and ProofWidgets at v0.0.72 / v0.073). We encourage all projects downstream of these to update when possible (and to release their own corresponding toolchain tags after updating). (Recall that you can use the lean-update github action to help automate this process.)

Also added to the release checklist this month is Cslib, available using the latest toolchains.
